newsitem.title: CHINA: HK gold recovers to end higher in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: HK gold recovers to end higher in quiet trade.

text.p: Hong Kong spot gold recovered and closed higher on Wednesday in quiet trade, dealers said.
Bullion ended at HK$318.50/319.00 per ounce, up from its weak open at US$317.30/80 an ounce.
"It's higher but trade was very quiet," said one trader.
He said prices recovered during the day after having been hammered at the start due to a fall in overnight prices. New York closed at US$320.20/70 on Tuesday.
Dealers said major support was seen at US$315-316.
Local gold closed at HK$2,957 per tael, up from HK$2,941 a tael at the open. --HONG KONG NEWSROOM (852) 2843-6441
